evidence_items.title: NTUYWANG103/EgoHandBench
evidence_items.summary: EgoHandBench is a benchmark for egocentric 3D hand reconstruction. It converts seven public datasets into the same format, removes frames with low-quality annotations, and fixes the train/test splits. It also provides the evaluator and ready-to-run baselines. Topics: 3d-hand-reconstruction, egocentric-pose-estimation, hand-object-interaction, hand-reconstruction, mano

evidence_items.title: PastiiJay/klbf-lab
evidence_items.summary: KLBF Lab: Xbox Series X|S compatibility layer for Windows. Runs the Xbox Series build of a title on PC from your own files. AMD Radeon fixes, AMD FSR 4 and frame generation, built-in benchmark. No game files. Topics: amd, compatibility-layer, d3d12, fsr, gdk, klbf, klbf-lab, radeon, rdna4, rust, scarlett, windows, xbox, xbox-series
